actors.name: Jair Bolsonaro
actors.blurb: Bolsonaro was admitted to the ICU in Brasília with an acute bowel obstruction, generating intense international media coverage regarding his health condition. Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized daily hospital visits by family members under strict conditions, including a complete ban on mobile phones and electronic devices.

actors.name: Javier Milei
actors.blurb: Milei headlined the official launch of Tesla in Argentina alongside a surprise appearance by Elon Musk, where he was presented with a custom Cybertruck emblazoned with his signature lion motif. The Argentine president used the platform to showcase his deregulation agenda and economic reforms while continuing his push for state privatizations.
